```{r}
library(flowWorkspace)
library(Luciernaga)
library(Coereba)
library(flowGate)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
```

```{r}
TheseScripts <- list.files("R", pattern=".R", full.names=TRUE)
walk(.x=TheseScripts, .f=source)
```

```{r}
Folder <- "Ctrl_Antibody"
Subset <- "CD8"

StorageLocation <- file.path("outputs", Folder, Subset)
DownsampledFolder <- file.path(StorageLocation, "Downsampled")
if (!dir.exists(DownsampledFolder)){dir.create(DownsampledFolder)}

CoerebaFolder <- file.path(StorageLocation, "Coereba")
if (!dir.exists(CoerebaFolder)){dir.create(CoerebaFolder)}

OutputLocation <- CoerebaFolder
```

Copy over prior effort. 
```{r}
PriorGates <- file.path("outputs", Folder, "CD4", "Coereba", "CD4Gates.csv")
SaveHere <- file.path(CoerebaFolder)
file.copy(PriorGates, SaveHere)
file.rename(file.path(CoerebaFolder, "CD4Gates.csv"),
            file.path(CoerebaFolder, "SecondGates.csv"))
```

```{r}
fcs_files <- list.files(StorageLocation,
 pattern=".fcs", full.names=TRUE)

UnmixedCytoSet <- load_cytoset_from_fcs(fcs_files,
 truncate_max_range=FALSE, transformation=FALSE)

UnmixedGatingSet <- GatingSet(UnmixedCytoSet)
```

## Downsampling

```{r}
#| eval: FALSE

DownsampledCD8s <- purrr::map(.x=UnmixedGatingSet, subset="root",
 .f=Downsampling, DownsampleCount=25000, addon="",
  returnType="fcs", StorageLocation=DownsampledFolder,
  inverse.transform=FALSE, negateUnderscore=TRUE)
```

```{r}
fcs_files <- list.files(DownsampledFolder,
 pattern=".fcs", full.names=TRUE)

UnmixedCytoSet <- load_cytoset_from_fcs(fcs_files,
 truncate_max_range=FALSE, transformation=FALSE)

UnmixedGatingSet <- GatingSet(UnmixedCytoSet)
```

## Metadata

Check the current metadata status.

```{r}
pData(UnmixedGatingSet)
```

```{r}
Bid <- function(filename) {
  bid <- str_extract(filename, "INF\\d{3}")
  bid <- data.frame(bid, check.names=FALSE)
}

Condition <- function(filename) {
  Condition <-str_extract(filename, "(?<=INF\\d{3}-)[A-Za-z]+(?=_Antibody)")
  Condition  <- data.frame(Condition, check.names=FALSE)
}

Experiment <- function(filename) {
  Experiment <- str_extract(filename, "ILT_\\d{2}")
  Experiment <- data.frame(Experiment, check.names=FALSE)
}
```

```{r}
pd <- pData(UnmixedGatingSet)

Names <- pd |> pull(name)

TheNames <- pd
TheBID <- map(.x=Names, .f=Bid) |> bind_rows()
TheCondition <- map(.x=Names, .f=Condition) |> bind_rows()
TheExperiment <- map(.x=Names, .f=Experiment) |> bind_rows()

TheIntermediate <- bind_cols(TheNames, TheBID, TheCondition, TheExperiment)
```

```{r}
TheMetadata <- file.path("data", "Metadata.csv")
TheMetadataDF <- read.csv(TheMetadata, check.names=FALSE)
AddThisMetada <- TheMetadataDF |> select(bid, ptype, infant_sex)
UpdatedMetadata <- left_join(TheIntermediate, AddThisMetada, by="bid")
rownames(UpdatedMetadata) <- rownames(pd)

pData(UnmixedGatingSet) <- UpdatedMetadata
```

```{r}
#| eval: FALSE
pData(UnmixedGatingSet) |> View()
```

## Transformation

Proceed to transform and visualize your data to ensure that everything looks okay before proceeding.

```{r}
#| label: "Biexponential Transformation"
#| message: false
Markers <- colnames(UnmixedCytoSet)
KeptMarkers <- Markers[-grep("Time|FS|SC|SS|Original|-W$|-H$|AF", Markers)]
MarkersForToday <- KeptMarkers

Biexponential <- flowjo_biexp_trans(channelRange=4096, maxValue=4194304,
     pos=5.62, neg=1, widthBasis=-1000)
TransformList <- transformerList(KeptMarkers, Biexponential)
UnmixedGatingSet <- transform(UnmixedGatingSet, TransformList)
```

```{r}
markernames(UnmixedGatingSet[1])
```

```{r}
ggcyto(UnmixedGatingSet[1], subset="root",
 aes(x="APC-Fire 750-A", y="BUV395-A")) + geom_hex(bins=100)
```

# Coereba

```{r}
TheGatingConstraints <- file.path("data", "UpdatedTemplateForGates.csv")
TheGateConstraintsCSV <- read.csv(TheGatingConstraints, check.names=FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| eval: FALSE

TheUpdatedGateCutoffs <- purrr::map(.x=UnmixedGatingSet, .f=Coereba_GateCutoffs,
  subset="root", sample.name=c("GROUPNAME", "TUBENAME"), desiredCols=MarkersForToday,
  GatingTemplate=TheGatingConstraints, GateOverwrite=FALSE) %>% bind_rows()

SecondGates <- file.path(OutputLocation, "SecondGates.csv")
write.csv(TheUpdatedGateCutoffs, SecondGates, row.names=FALSE)
```

```{r}
SecondGatesPath <- file.path(OutputLocation, "SecondGates.csv")
SecondGates <- read.csv(SecondGatesPath, check.names=FALSE)
```

We can then run `Coereba_UpdateGates()` and examine how the values are correspondingly updated.

```{r}
ShinyGatesSplitpoints <- Coereba_UpdateGates(Clicks=TheClickInfo, Old=TheOldCSV,
  export=FALSE, outpath=OutputLocation, fileName="UpdatedCSV")

ShinyGatesSplitpoints
```

```{r}
TheName <- paste0(Subset, "Gates.csv")

ShinyGatesPath <- file.path(OutputLocation, TheName)
write.csv(ShinyGatesSplitpoints, ShinyGatesPath, row.names=FALSE)
```
